key_insight: TopoMamba improves topology prediction by combining load-support physics with a multi-directional Mamba state-space model to better capture mechanical dependencies.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a more efficient and generalizable surrogate for topology optimization, helping design stronger structures with lower compute cost.
method: Guides feature learning using load-support relations between physical fields.
Uses spatially adaptive fusion to weight multi-directional scan features by local conditions.
Couples Mamba with SIMP to improve mechanical performance while keeping computation efficient.
evidence_signal: On two-dimensional topology optimization benchmarks, the method reports superior prediction accuracy, out-of-distribution generalization, and computational efficiency versus state-of-the-art models.
watch_item: Performance is demonstrated on 2D benchmarks, so scalability to more complex 3D or highly nonlinear structural settings remains to be validated.
paper_title: TopoMamba: A Load-Support Relation-Guided Multi-Directional State-Space Model for Topology Optimization
